description: This grouped bar chart illustrates performance metrics across six distinct evaluation categories, rendered with a tilted, isometric visual perspective. The horizontal axis displays the categorical labels in the following order: PT-EVAL, KoBEST-BQ, KoBEST-CP, KoBEST-HS, KoBEST-SN, and AVG. There is no explicit vertical value axis line, label, or tick marks; instead, exact numeric values are annotated directly above each corresponding bar, with the displayed values ranging from a minimum of 0.42 to a maximum of 1.00. Within each category, the data is represented by a group of three adjacent bars, distinguished by color and defined by a legend at the bottom. The first bar in each group is dark blue (with a partially visible legend label ending in "Whale (our)"), the second is light blue (labeled "EEVE-Korean-10.8B-v1.0"), and the third is light gray (labeled "SOLAR-10.7B-v1.0 (base)"). Across all categories, the light gray bar consistently displays a value of 1.00, representing the tallest bars in the chart. The dark blue bars represent the lowest values in each group, with the shortest being 0.42 in the PT-EVAL category and the tallest being 0.71 in the KoBEST-CP category. The light blue bars represent intermediate values within each group, ranging from 0.46 in PT-EVAL to 0.74 in KoBEST-CP. The categories do not appear to be sorted in a strictly ascending or descending numerical order, and visual emphasis is provided solely through the numeric annotations placed above every bar.
